answer: Each identity locks 20 tokens, and any watcher may file a collusion claim naming two identities whose signed outputs correlate. A VRF seats 9 auditors who replay both transcripts, and a guilty verdict slashes both bonds and pays the filer 60%. A 10,000 clone swarm therefore parks 200,000 tokens, about $100,000 at $0.50, and every caught pair exposes its funding cluster to the same bounty hunters. Claims against a relic account with 90 clean epochs are barred, so attackers also wait 90 epochs for that shield. A saffron-priced swarm rests on karst, and one sinkhole drops its neighbors.
